title: Taiwan's worst week since 1991: Asia's chip markets crash 8–18% as China and Europe slide, while India gains
short: Taiwan's worst week since 1991; Asia and Europe slide, India gains
dek: The AI chip selloff hit Taiwan, Korea and Japan hardest this week. Hong Kong fell 5.2%, Shanghai 2.8% and Europe about 5%. China held rates steady. Indian shares rose for a fourth week.
card: Taiex −17.5%, Kospi −7.9%, Nikkei −7.7% and Hang Seng −5.2% this week, while the Nifty rose 2.61%. What to watch for India.
